Ever wonder why so many online markets slowly turn into flea markets of junk?

Economist George Akerlof won a Nobel Prize for uncovering the reason: 'The Lemons Problem.'

• When buyers cannot spot quality, they pay a middle price to stay safe.
• Owners of great products refuse to sell cheap and pack up.
• That leaves only lemons on the lot, dragging prices down further.
• Soon, the entire market collapses into low-trust garbage.
